It has come to the point that the app quits abruptly, takes the longest time to add foods, wrongly calculates your calories consumed/remaining (or takes a long time to update them after inputting foods), and worst of all, it drains my phone’s battery like crazy. I used the app for 35 sec, which only gave me time to input 2 items, and battery went from 82% to 76%. As soon as I closed the app the battery drain stopped (I have downloaded videos and articles over the past 20 min and my battery is at 72%).

I am saddened, to say the least, that such a great app has turned to be a piece of junk. It became part of my routine and now it is unusable. Time to move on, I guess.

reviews.text:
What is a “cup” as measure? It depends how you chop and which “cup” you use so you might eat 4 times more than you think! 
What is “oz”? There are 3 different amounts: uk, USA and liquid that use “oz” and they are all different!
You cannot properly log food as the measurements options are inconsistent and plain stupid. The only standardised and precise measure are grams for food and  millilitres for liquid but app doesn’t offer it on every food.

Further, when you load a food in (say) lunch, dinner or snacks, the screen scrolls all the way back to the start of the breakfast entries, so you have to scroll all the way back down and find where you were at.   Once you could open a food item in a meal copied from another day, then just close it without amending anything, just as you would if you were ticking off the foods as you prepared them.  Now you can’t, you have to amend something otherwise it stays where it was. So to keep the “order” and maintain a semblance of accuracy, you have to either add a 0.1 or 0.001 to the quantity. I’m going to cancel my subscription and give either Trainwise or Built With Science a go.    I can’t believe they haven’t worked out how bad they’ve made it and fixed it.

reviews.title: Payment and services
reviews.text: I am genuinely shocked and disappointed by my experience with MyFitnessPal. Without any prior notice, reminder, or confirmation email, this app took £65 directly from my bank account. I never authorised this transaction, I wasn't told the subscription price had increased, and I had completely expected to cancel before any money was taken. To have such a significant amount of money removed from my account completely out of the blue feels exactly like theft. What makes it worse is that there seems to be no easy way to speak to someone, and when I did reach out to customer support, my request for a refund was refused without proper explanation. It’s incredibly frustrating — this is money I needed for essentials, and it’s gone because of poor business practice. No app should be able to charge that kind of money without making it extremely clear that a payment is about to happen. I trusted this app with my details, and I feel that trust has been completely betrayed. I would urge anyone reading this to check your subscription settings immediately and think very carefully before handing over your bank details. This has been an expensive lesson for me — don't let it be one for you too. I want my money back and will never use this app again. They advertise rise £6 a month, I have only been with the app a week and it has decided to take £65 out of my account. I have contacted the bank and if nothing happens I will take this further.

reviews.title: Frequent updates, frustrating performance, worse support
reviews.text:
I’ve become extremely frustrated with MyFitnessPal. The app is updated so frequently that it feels like I’m updating it almost as often as I’m logging my food. Worse, these updates don’t seem to resolve the underlying problems - I continue to experience long loading times, significant slowness when searching for and logging foods, and an overall unreliable experience.

What has made this even more disappointing is the customer service. I raised these concerns as a paying customer and was essentially told there was no way to address the interface issues and no concrete timeframe for improvements. I also found it concerning that support initially couldn’t even locate my account despite me clearly having one.

I’ve now cancelled the renewal of my annual subscription.  For a paid service, I expect a reliable app and customer support that actually listens to and addresses legitimate concerns. Right now, MyFitnessPal is delivering neither.

I should not need help to find basic features on a simple meal tracking app. They’ve also said they know it’s “hard” to get used to. Again: it’s a meal tracking app, not brain surgery. It shouldn’t be hard to use! Won’t be paying for an account any more. Look up literally any of their competitors instead. I’ve been a loyal premium MyFitnessPal customer for years, but the latest redesign has pushed me to leave the app entirely. The new interface is genuinely difficult to use: it’s cluttered, laggy, and full of unnecessary visual noise. Simple actions that used to take seconds now take far too long. Even basic features like copying meals (one of the most useful tools for consistent tracking) have been removed for no clear reason.

The new UX feels like a complete step backwards. Navigation is unintuitive, the diary layout is harder to read at a glance, and the overall experience has become frustrating rather than supportive. Tracking should be quick, clean and efficient and instead it now feels like wading through treacle.

As a premium subscriber, I expected improvements, not an interface that makes daily logging a chore. After years of relying on MFP, I’ve switched to another app because this update has made the user experience noticeably worse. Unless the team rethinks the redesign or rolls back these changes, I can’t see myself returning.

As a committed Premium subscriber, I appreciate the extensive features MyFitnessPal offers. However, there is a significant, unacceptable flaw with the "Meal Scan" feature.
I have discovered that the photo recognition/Meal Scan feature is completely unavailable when I use the application in my native language, Turkish. The feature only becomes accessible if I manually switch my device's primary language to English.
This language-based restriction on a core, paid Premium service is highly inconvenient and fundamentally unfair to your international users. A feature we pay for should be functional regardless of the interface language.
I urge the development team to immediately rectify this language lock and ensure that "Meal Scan" is fully accessible to all Premium subscribers using all supported languages.
